paper.title: EFC Perturbation Sector
paper.description: Key numerical values extracted from the EFC Perturbation Sector paper, describing the effective lensing ratio Sigma_eff(z)/Sigma_CDM. Redshifts below correspond to Euclid DR1 tomographic bin centres.

alpha_LCDM.description: EFC coupling parameter value that recovers the LCDM limit.

crossover_redshift.description: Redshift at which Sigma_eff/Sigma_CDM = 1 (crossover from enhanced to suppressed lensing). Value corresponds to the Euclid DR1 tomographic bin centre identified in the paper (Table, Sec. 3).

regime_enhanced.description: Gravitational lensing is enhanced (Sigma_eff > Sigma_CDM) at low redshift.

regime_suppressed.description: Gravitational lensing is suppressed (Sigma_eff < Sigma_CDM) at high redshift.
